svg.title: Gantry desktop — organization admin, visual proposal, not implemented
svg.desc: Follow-up to desktop-views-study.svg. An organization source for administrators: Hosts, Policy, Review, Rollouts, History, and Enrollment for pushing organization policy generations to enrolled host managers through the policy feed. All names and records are sample data.
svg.text: GANTRY / DESIGN STUDY 04
Publish once. See every host catch up.
An organization source for administrators: draft a profile, review what it changes, sign it on this machine, and follow each enrolled host from offered to acknowledged.
VISUAL PROPOSAL · SAMPLE DATA
HOW A POLICY REACHES A SANDBOX
The desktop publishes; hosts pull. Screens show what hosts report, never an assumed push.
This desktop
Organization admin
Draft, review, and sign a generation
Signing key stays on this machine
Policy service
policy.acme.dev
Feed, rings, and the remote catalog
Records what each host reports
Host managers

text.font-family: Adwaita Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: gantry serve -policy-feed
24 enrolled, one profile per host
Verify with the pinned public key
Sandboxes
every saved sandbox on the host
Running: updated live
Stopped: at next start · failures fail closed
publish signed bundle
as the next generation · HTTPS
poll · mTLS
reports applied generation + digest
answers with its ring's generation
fan out
one fail-closed transaction each
Hosts — Which generation is each host enforcing?
Every enrolled host by ring, with the generation it last reported, when it last polled, and when its identity expires.

g.text: Generations as each host last reported them
Showing 11 of 24 hosts · sorted by ring · certificates show days until the host identity expires

g.text: Received g42 but hasn't acknowledged it.
A sandbox that can't reconcile stays stopped,
and the host retries on every poll. Which one
shows on that host's Audit screen, not here.

One profile at a time, laid out like Network Rules. Changes since the last signed generation are marked in the margin.

svg.text: Rollouts — Watch a generation land, ring by ring
Offered and acknowledged come from each host's own polls. Rings advance by hand, and a stalled host is called out.

g.text: The host makes its own key.
You sign only its certificate request; the
private key never reaches this desktop.

text.font-family: Adwaita Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

g.text: Enrolling a new host into acme

svg.text: Hosts pull; the desktop publishes
Offered and acknowledged come from each host's own poll: the generation and digest it applied.
Generations only move forward
A number is never served twice. Rolling back republishes an old signed bundle as a new one.
The signing key never leaves
Hosts verify every bundle against the key they pinned at enrollment, not the service's word.

LAYOUT STUDY ONLY — follows desktop-views-study.svg. Needs an admin API on the organization's policy service (publish, rings, per-host reports); Gantry ships only the feed receiver today. Names, counts, and times are sample data.
